subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus an API/plugin/adapter path, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Design opt-in sync boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Move to plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by putting Open WebUI-specific mirroring behind a plugin or integration boundary and adding only any missing generic core seam.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with live Docker/OpenWebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat/session ownership signals make this the best available routing owner for the product and persistence-boundary decision.
